summary: CID HoldCo filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026, disclosing that CEO Nabrotzky, CFO/COO Maddox and CTO Nambiar forgave $368,107.25 of outstanding principal and interest under unsecured subordinated executive notes (7.5% per annum, due December 31, 2026). In exchange, the company paid roughly $37,075 in cash (about 10% of the debt) and issued 55,613 common shares at a deemed $6.00 per share, at or above the Nasdaq Minimum Price. The transaction is a debt-to-equity settlement reducing leverage; watch dilution and insider ownership shifts.
